_comment: Every item that fails any gate lands here with the reason, timestamp, and which gate failed. Never silently discarded or forced through. Reviewed periodically to spot systemic issues (e.g. a gate that's too strict, or a recurring source problem).

short_form.gate: basic_qa (quality risk, Agent 0 judgement call — no literal gates.json rule directly covers this case)
short_form.reason: Produced file (assets/short-form-clips/processed/sf_001.mp4, 1080x1920, 29s, verified via ffprobe) correctly applied the short_form_gates.copyright_gate mitigation checklist in full (vertical reframe, 0.90x speed change + color grade, 5 burned-in on-screen-text beats, original audio fully replaced with a verified CC0 track). However, the script's voiceover_script (full narrated spoken-word lines that are the core creative device of this candidate's angle) was never added — no TTS engine is available in this environment, so Agent 3.1's own mandatory checklist step 6 (voiceover) was left incomplete by necessity, not oversight. Publishing a spoken-word-monologue concept with zero spoken words as the channel's first-ever video is a quality/creative-intent mismatch significant enough to withhold rather than auto-publish under a gate that doesn't explicitly anticipate this case. Holding for a human decision: accept text-only shorts as the format going forward, or add a TTS step to the pipeline before this candidate (or others like it) can publish.
short_form.additional_note: Visual clip selection (56.mp4, 50.mp4, 39.mp4, looped ABCABC to reach 29s) was also only a weak heuristic (file size as a low-motion proxy) since no video-viewing capability exists to genuinely match visual_direction; flagged for awareness, not treated as a separate gate failure.
short_form.cc0_track_used: Phonk ish by HoliznaCC0 (CC0 1.0, verified) — this part of the pipeline worked correctly and the track is retained in state/cc0_audio_library.json for reuse.

long_form.gate: long_form_gates.image_copyright_gate (environment/credentials blocker, not a content failure)
long_form.reason: Stage 2.2 (Image Sourcer) could not run: the `banana` skill requires a Google AI (Gemini) API key, and none is configured anywhere in this environment (no GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY env var, no MCP server registration, no ~/.banana config, no gcloud application-default credentials). Independently re-verified by Agent 0 via scripts/validate_setup.py and an env/config scan before quarantining, to rule out a subagent false negative. No image was generated, and per the hard image_copyright_gate requirement (generated only, never scraped/substituted), no placeholder or non-AI-generated image was used as a workaround. Stage 3.2 (Animator) and Stage 5 (Assembler) were consequently not attempted since they depend on the image.
long_form.brief_status: The scouted brief (title, visual_theme, mood, SEO, target_length_minutes=60) is sound and screened clean against content_exclusions — retained in state/long_form_queue.json for reuse once image generation is unblocked, rather than discarded.
long_form.audio_status: A verified CC0 ambient track was already sourced for this candidate's mood ('Rain _ Sleep _ Meditation' by HoliznaCC0, CC0 1.0, verified) and is in state/cc0_audio_library.json, ready to use once the pipeline can proceed.
long_form.unblock_action_needed: A Google AI Studio API key (free tier available at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) needs to be added to this environment before the banana skill / long-form image generation can run. This is a one-time setup step, not something Agent 0 can resolve autonomously.
